model_annotation: Figure 4 illustrates the performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on BioMedLM, where “Base” denotes the LLM without editing. The x-axis represents the Co-occurrence Number, displayed on a logarithmic scale ranging from 0 to 10³, with tick labels at 0, 10¹, 10², and 10³. The y-axis shows ACC (%) on a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 65, with tick marks every 5 units. Four lines are plotted: Base (blue solid line with circle markers), MEND (green dashed line with square markers), IKE (red dash-dotted line with triangle markers), and ROME (purple dotted line with diamond markers). The Base line starts at approximately 45% ACC at 10¹ co-occurrence and rises to about 48% at 10³. The MEND line begins at about 50% at 10¹ and increases to approximately 60% at 10³. The IKE line starts at roughly 45% at 10¹ and reaches about 52% at 10³. The ROME line begins at approximately 52% at 10¹ and rises to around 58% at 10³. All lines show a general upward trend as co-occurrence number increases, with MEND and ROME achieving the highest ACC values across the range.
